Topics · One God, one message

Is all disagreement bad?

Two prophets differ; the Quran praises both. When is disagreement a blessing, when division? Ask the heart.

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ٧٨ فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ٧٩﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night],[896] and We were witness to their judgement. And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].[897]

Translator's notes

[896] Eating and destroying the crops.

[897] Meaning that Allāh has always been capable of accomplishing whatever He wills.

Quran · Al-Anbiya 21:78-79

Translation

David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

Original · Hebrew

וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖ד עַל־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י דָוִ֗ד עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־עַמּֽוֹ׃

2 Samuel · 8:15

World English Bible

If all disagreement were bad, two prophets differing over one case would be in something bad. These verses show David and Solomon judging the same case, say Solomon had the finer understanding, and add at once that each was given wisdom and knowledge. So there is a disagreement with no blame in it: two people seeking what is right, one reaching closer, the other still honoured. Disagreement as such is not the problem.

A question for you

What makes a disagreement like David and Solomon's possible?

If you saySeeking truth, not victory
ThenA simple test you can run: if the other turned out to be nearer the truth, would you be glad?
If you sayLove between the two
ThenYes, and division begins when that goes. See the next part.
If you sayThey were prophets; this does not apply to us
ThenA fair point. Then look at a verse that speaks to all people about their differing.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمُهَيْمِنًا عَلَيْهِ ۖ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَهُم بِمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ عَمَّا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ لِكُلٍّ جَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ شِرْعَةً وَمِنْهَاجًا ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَجَعَلَكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَبْلُوَكُمْ فِى مَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَٱسْتَبِقُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَرْجِعُكُمْ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in truth, confirming that which preceded it of the Scripture and as a criterion over it. So judge between them by what Allāh has revealed and do not follow their inclinations away from what has come to you of the truth. To each of you We prescribed a law and a method.[268] Had Allāh willed, He would have made you one nation [united in religion], but [He intended] to test you in what He has given you; so race to [all that is] good.[269] To Allāh is your return all together, and He will [then] inform you concerning that over which you used to differ.

Translator's notes

[268] Prior to this revelation, which supersedes all previous scriptures. [269] i.e., obedience to Allāh according to what He enjoined in the Qur’ān and through the sunnah of His Prophet (ﷺ).

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:48

Translation

The fear of Yahweh is clean, enduring forever. Yahweh’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether. They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb. Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

Original · Hebrew

יִרְאַ֤ת יְהוָ֨ה ׀ טְהוֹרָה֮ עוֹמֶ֪דֶת לָ֫עַ֥ד מִֽשְׁפְּטֵי־יְהוָ֥ה אֱמֶ֑ת צָֽדְק֥וּ יַחְדָּֽו׃ הַֽנֶּחֱמָדִ֗ים מִ֭זָּהָב וּמִפַּ֣ז רָ֑ב וּמְתוּקִ֥ים מִ֝דְּבַ֗שׁ וְנֹ֣פֶת צוּפִֽים׃ גַּֽם־עַ֭בְדְּךָ נִזְהָ֣ר בָּהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְרָ֗ם עֵ֣קֶב רָֽב׃

the Psalms · 19:9-11

World English Bible

This verse answers a question: what do we do with our differences? In three steps: grant that each people has a way, turn the energy into a race for good, and leave the settling to God. Three things keep disagreement healthy: acknowledging the other, working, and humility before the end. Without them, difference turns into something else. What is asked is not that we agree, but that we know what to do when we do not.

A question for you

Of the three steps, which is hardest for you?

If you sayAcknowledging the other
ThenAcknowledging is not agreeing. A question of its own takes that up: being sure and still respecting others.
If you sayRacing for good
ThenA practical answer. One step may be enough to begin.
If you sayLeaving the verdict to God
ThenIt is the heaviest thing to let go of, and there is a rest in it that only those who try can know.

Part 3 of 3

﴿وَمَا تَفَرَّقُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى لَّقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُورِثُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ لَفِى شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word[1413] that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Scripture after them are, concerning it, in disquieting doubt.

Translator's notes

[1413] Decree. See footnote to 10:19.

1 Corinthians · 3:3

World English Bible

﴿وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُوا۟ وَٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. And those will have a great punishment

Quran · Aal Imran 3:105

Translation

Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

Original · Ancient Greek

καὶ ἐξ ὑμῶν αὐτῶν ἀναστήσονται ἄνδρες λαλοῦντες διεστραμμένα τοῦ ἀποσπᾶν τοὺς μαθητὰς ὀπίσω ἑαυτῶν·

Acts · 20:30

World English Bible

So where does disagreement become division? The first verse gives two words: rivalry among them. They did not split for lack of knowing, but because some wanted to rise over others. The difference is not in the subject of the dispute but in the heart. As long as you seek the truth, you are in a disagreement. Once you want your brother to lose, division has begun. The second verse speaks to believers directly: do not be like those who split.

A question for you

Name a disagreement you are living now: do you want to know, or to win?
